## Greater Horned Ghoul (CR 5)

This gray-skinned behemoth is nearly 8 feet tall, with arms like tree trunks, enormously distended stomach and a toothy maw cavernous enough to swallow a man whole.  

**XP** 1,600  
CE Medium undead  
**Init** +4; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft, scent.; Perception +12; Aura stench (30 ft., DC 17, 1d10 minutes)  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 10, flat-footed 16 (+6 natural)  
**hp** 66 (7d8+35)  
**Fort** +6, **Ref** +2, **Will** +7  
**Defensive Abilities** channel resistance +2; **Immune** undead traits  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** bite +11 (2d6+5 plus grab and filth fever), 2 claws +11 (1d8+5), gore +10 (1d8+5)  
**Special Attacks** extended jaw, feed, filth fever, regurgitate, swallow whole (2d6 bludgeoning damage, AC 13, hp 6)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 11, Con—, **Int** 2, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +5; **CMB** +10 (+14 grapple); **CMD** 20  
**Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Weapon Focus (bite, claw), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Perception +12  


**Special Abilities**


**Filth Fever (Ex)** Bite—injury; *save* Fort DC 17; onset 1day; *frequency* 1/day; *effect* 1d3 Con and 1d3 Dex damage; *cure* 2 consecutive saves. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Extended Jaw (Ex)** A greater horned ghoul can stretch its jaw and stomach at great rates, allowing it to swallow whole a creature up to its own size.  

**Feed (Su)** By spending a full-round action devouring the body of a dead or helpless creature within a size category of itself, a horned ghoul gains 2d8 temporary hit points and a +2 bonus on attack and damage rolls for 1 minute. The temporary hit points stack up to 40, but disappear after 1 hour. Each such feeding also provides the horned ghoul with a growth point. When a horned ghoul reaches two growth points, it gains the advanced simple template, although without the increase to intelligence. When a horned ghoul reaches five growth points, it loses all its growth points and transforms into a greater horned ghoul. A greater horned ghoul that reaches five growth points gains an advanced simple template (with no increase to Int), and at 10 points the giant simple template (with an increase to Charisma instead of Constitution).  

**Regurgitate (Ex)** A greater horned ghoul can expel the contents of its stomach as a ranged touch attack with a range of 20 feet. A target hit by the regurgitation must make two DC 17 Fortitude saves, the first to resist contracting filth fever, and the second to avoid being nauseated for 1 minute. Once a greater horned ghoul uses this ability it can’t use it again until it feeds. The save DCs are Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any land  
**Organization** solitary, gang (2–4), or pack (1-5 plus up to 30 smaller horned ghouls)  
**Treasure** incidental
